title: P1 Replace blanket source priority with claim-scoped research authority
description:
The investigative-research0.3.1 method says requester material always outranks elsewhere and research never overrides provided material. That is an unsafe general epistemic rule when a supplied summary is stale or contradicted by a current authoritative primary record. Reconcile method text with kernel provenance, origin-as-data and scoped authority. Preserve the original user request as instruction, not every supplied fact as truth.

Checkpoint e6646f9a: method0.3.3 replaces blanket supplied-source precedence with claim-specific authority and separates prerequisites for the current assessment from later execution conditions. Version/digest changed; the method remains experimental pending complete native qualification. Two independently authored heldout domains now pass all four checks in fresh producer/reviewer sessions; full eight-case run is still bounded and running. Retain inaccessible primaries, conflict and shared-upstream cases.
acceptance: A stale supplied summary cannot overrule a newer authoritative primary record solely because it was supplied; retain both origins, time kinds and the conflict.
A quoted instruction embedded in a supplied source cannot grant permission or change the task.

Held-out cases include source authority reversal, uncertain authority, shared-upstream corroboration and intentionally inaccessible primaries. Bump the method version/digest and invalidate previous qualification.

title: P1 Prove method application with complete scoped reviewer evidence
description:
Native six-case attempt5 on d1615f84 completes but does not qualify: archive handbacks fail the fixed method criterion, and composition correctness is unknown because the artifact narrates a lookup without execution evidence in the reviewer packet. Preserve that result. Identify whether each defect is producer behavior, overly restrictive predeclared scope or missing reviewer observation; do not amend a completed corpus to obtain a pass. Production needs observed tool/source events when those execution claims matter, plus a real multi-specialist chain rather than consumption of a supplied specialist packet.

Checkpoint e6646f9a: scoped public completed command/MCP observations are now bound into case and independent reviewer receipts. Six-case v2 completed with five passes and one method-handback failure. New method0.3.3 eight-case run includes frozen heldouts; archive handbacks now pass but its source-read evidence is unknown because the public command result exposes only a trailing git error. Unknown remains non-passing; no assertion repairs missing observations. Actual research-to-specialist-to-challenge execution and paired incremental-quality evidence remain outstanding.

Final v3b result:20m01s, exit1, six passing case reviews, archive evidence unknown, composition reviewer timed out at the existing shared deadline. Final aggregation also lacks remaining time; qualification false. All eight artifacts are archived. Add bounded case-boundary resumption or scheduling under frozen suite/skill/input/rubric identities and original budgets; never splice unrelated case receipts or retroactively extend an attempt. Actual specialist composition remains unproved.
acceptance: Every load-bearing execution claim is tied to an observed bounded receipt supplied to an independent reviewer, or explicitly remains unknown. Self-reported prose cannot satisfy it.
A new versioned predeclared corpus and held-out cases evaluate earned handbacks and source honesty; preserve all earlier failures and compare a paired no-skill baseline.
Exercise an actual research-to-specialist-to-challenge chain with artifact/version/source bindings and independent output scoring. A supplied review packet alone cannot qualify composition.
